description: When an existing agent mandate already exists (drafted or proposed for DDAO sign-off) and you need a first-pass audit before go-live or regulatory inspection: does it cover the decision perimeter, the escalation thresholds, the kill switch, the audit trail, the documentation duty?: get a structured preliminary verdict with strengths, gaps, required additions, and explicit gaps_to_validate for the human reviewer.
name: acf.evaluate-agent-mandate
